_comment: Rename to manifest.json once the audio exists. Missing files fall back to the synth, so partial sets are fine. Deliver DRY — the engine adds the hull.

cantor_name_5.speaker: cantor
cantor_name_5.text: It's only the one note, Wren.

cantor_name_6.speaker: cantor
cantor_name_6.text: You tuned it. You should hear it.

wren_ch0_0.speaker: wren
wren_ch0_0.text: The chamber door was shut. That is the only reason.

wren_ch0_1.speaker: wren
wren_ch0_1.text: They're blind. Whatever it did to them, it took the eyes first.

wren_ch0_2.speaker: wren
wren_ch0_2.text: Body shots do nothing. Cut the parts that are lit.

wren_ch1_0.speaker: wren
wren_ch1_0.text: Something down here is holding a note. It hasn't stopped for eleven months.

wren_ch1_1.speaker: wren
wren_ch1_1.text: That's Kofi's voice. That's my name in Kofi's voice.

wren_ch1_2.speaker: wren
wren_ch1_2.text: It doesn't want to catch me. It wants me to hold still and listen.

wren_ch2_0.speaker: wren
wren_ch2_0.text: Bearing two nine one point four. That's my alignment. That's the number I cut.

wren_ch2_1.speaker: wren
wren_ch2_1.text: We didn't receive anything. We answered something.

wren_ch2_2.speaker: wren
wren_ch2_2.text: Shutting the array down does nothing. It already knows where we are.
